{{Quote|Look, we're kind of busy here, so if that's all you need to know"<br />"Sorry, I wish this could wait, but I'm only passing through on my way to Ramodi."<br />"The baradium ring? I thought Tesar Sebatyne was supposed to handle that."<br />"Supposed to is right. Something came up."<br />"Bigger than smuggling baradium?|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Kyp Durron]]|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
'''Ramodi''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CER">{{CSWECite|III|77|Ramodi}}</ref> located in the [[Ramodi system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Tregillis sector/Legends|Tregillis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> About five years after the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], this planet was the site of a sizable [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]]-smuggling ring.<ref name="CER" /> In [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tesar Sebatyne]] was dispatched by the [[New Jedi Order]] to Ramodi to investigate baradium smuggling, but he abandoned the mission after hearing [[UnuThul|mysterious]] call from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="JK" /><ref name="CER" /> Soon, senior [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyp Durron]] took over the mission of Tesar Sebatyne.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ramodi was first mentioned in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'', written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="JK" /> In [[2008]],<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/160596/the-complete-star-wars-encyclopedia-by-stephen-j-sansweet-pablo-hidalgo-bob-vitas-daniel-wallace/9780345477637|text=The Complete Star Wars® Encyclopedia}}</ref> an entry for Ramodi was added to the reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which revealed that it was a planet.<ref name="CER" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Ramodi system/Legends|Ramodi star system]] and the planet itself in grid square M-15.<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
